Zeenat Aman suggests live-in relationships for compatibility testing

Veteran actress Zeenat Aman has spoken in favor of live-in relationships, suggesting that couples should consider them to test compatibility before marriage. She argued that five happy years in a live-in relationship might be preferable to fifteen unhappy years in a marriage. Aman's statements have sparked discussion on modern relationships and pre-marital compatibility.
